executive_summary:
This episode centers on the September 10, 2025 evidence-handling behavior of Terrell Farnsworth, Turning Point USA's audio-visual lead. The host presents read-aloud excerpts from Farnsworth's 1102 sworn statement, an audio clip of SBI Agent David Hull's preliminary-hearing testimony, a clip from YouTuber Nissi's back-camera comparison video, and an audio excerpt of Andrew Kolvet's Tucker Carlson appearance explaining the SD-card removal as protection against "evil people." The episode's evidentiary centerpiece is newly released footage allegedly showing Farnsworth pocketing the SD card, looking around, and immediately texting on his phone after the camera removal.

The episode advances several investigative questions: (1) whether Farnsworth's claimed Google-hacking fear was a lie, given his same-day Google Drive transmission; (2) whether footage from behind Charlie Kirk's head was specifically clipped and zoomed in; (3) whether FBI involvement in a state-level Utah homicide is procedurally anomalous, supported by a clip of former CIA officer John Kirraou. The episode also presents a Joe Rogan Experience clip in which panelists discuss apparent perspective distortion in a published Tyler Robinson identification photo, and a WearForbidden parody video.

Structurally, this episode functions as evidence-chain and chain-of-custody consolidation prior to the next development in the series.

claims.label: Per 1102 Statement Host Shows, Terrell Farnsworth Used Google Drive to Send Four Videos to SBI on September 10
claims.claim: Per Terrell Farnsworth's 1102 statement, which the host shows and reads, he provided SBI with four videos through a Google Drive on September 10, 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the existence and timestamps of the four Google Drive videos referenced in the 1102 statement; obtain authenticated copy of the statement.

claims.label: Terrell Farnsworth's Google-Hacking Fear Is Contradicted by His Same-Day Google Drive Usage
claims.claim: Farnsworth told the host on or about September 18 that he feared Google would hack him, despite having transmitted footage via Google Drive eight days earlier.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the September 18 phone-call recording or contemporaneous notes; compare with the September 10 Google Drive transmission timestamp.

claims.label: TPUSA Initially Provided a Flash Drive and Google Links, Not Original SD Cards
claims.claim: SBI Agent David Hull testified that Farnsworth originally provided a flash drive to Lieutenant O'Brien, then downloadable Google links to Agent Mortonson on September 10, with the 1102 collected later on May 6, 2026 – not the SD cards.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain certified preliminary-hearing transcript; confirm whether SD cards were ever handed over directly and to whom.

claims.label: In Clip Host Plays, YouTuber Nissi Says Back-Camera Footage on September 10 Was Zoomed In Versus Wide-Angle Convention
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, YouTuber Nissi compares the back-camera shot at UVU on September 10 with wide-angle back-camera shots from FSU, USC, San Francisco, San Diego, Long Beach, Boise, and Washington State, and concludes the September 10 footage was zoomed in or cropped rather than the conventional wide angle.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original uncropped September 10 back-camera footage; obtain Nissi's source clips from other tour stops for direct frame comparison.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet Publicly Defended SD-Card Removal as Protection Against "Evil People"
claims.claim: Kolvet stated on Tucker Carlson that Farnsworth removed the SD cards "because I know people can be evil," and described witnessing theft of hats from the table after the incident.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full Tucker Carlson interview segment; identify whether the SD cards referenced match the singular SD card observed being removed.

claims.label: Andrew Kolvet is the 'Kolvet' of C-3294 (revises C-3294)
claims.claim: C-3294 spells the speaker 'Andrew Kolvet' (auto-caption form). The speaker is Andrew Kolvet (N-14). He stated on Tucker Carlson that Farnsworth (N-263) removed the SD cards "because I know people can be evil," and described witnessing theft of hats from the table after the incident.
claims.investigative_direction: Read with C-3294; match the Tucker Carlson segment under the corrected spelling Andrew Kolvet.
claims.transcript_snippet: He said, "Because I know people can be evil."

claims.label: Footage Behind Charlie's Head Was Specifically Clipped Into a Short Segment Labeled 80704
claims.claim: Farnsworth's 1102 statement describes clip 80704 as a "true and correct representation of a portion of the larger files" for the back-camera footage specifically, indicating the full back-camera file was clipped into a discrete segment.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original four-video files referenced in the 1102; compare lengths and metadata against the 80704 clip to determine clip origin.

claims.label: Exclusive Footage Shows Farnsworth Pocketing SD Card, Looking Around, and Texting
claims.claim: Newly released footage shows Farnsworth placing the SD card in his pocket, zipping the pocket, scanning surroundings, then using his phone to send a text message within minutes of the camera removal.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain chain-of-custody for the newly released footage itself; identify the text-message recipient via phone records or subpoena.

claims.label: Former CIA Officer Publicly Questioned FBI Primary Involvement in Utah State Homicide
claims.claim: John Kirraou stated on the Danny Jones podcast that no element of the September 9/10 case crossed state lines and therefore nothing should make it federal unless a conspiracy existed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain full Danny Jones podcast segment; verify whether FBI has filed any federal charges or maintains any formal federal nexus.

claims.label: Per Rogan Clip Host Plays, Published Tyler Robinson Photo Showed Perspective Distortion
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays from the Joe Rogan show, Rogan and his guests discuss the published photo of Tyler Robinson, which they say appeared to have a wider man "shrunken" into Robinson's proportions, with distorted car-hood proportions behind him.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the original source of the published Robinson photo; obtain metadata and EXIF data; compare with independently sourced photographs of Robinson.

claims.label: Host Presents WearForbidden Video Parodying "Positive Evidence" / Pickle Pup
claims.claim: The host says the account WearForbidden released a parody video featuring an Erika Kirk-style character with "Shabbat shalom," "I CHOOSE YOU. PICKLE PUP," and a repeated "positive evidence" refrain, and plays it on the show.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the WearForbidden source video for direct verification of framing and content.

claims.label: Host Asserts She Has Known Farnsworth's Post-Removal Behavior Since October
claims.claim: The host claims she has known since October what Farnsworth did after removing the camera, and is now publicly releasing the footage.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source from whom the host obtained the footage in October; verify timing of receipt.

claims.label: Host Concurs with Zamut and Golf/Cadence Comments Praising Her Work
claims.claim: The host expresses agreement with comments framing her investigation as a "blessing" and complimenting her music taste.
claims.investigative_direction: No investigative direction; commentary-concurrence claim.

claims.label: Host Alleges Crowder Brought a CEO Into Her Home to Join His Show From the Playroom
claims.claim: The host says Steven Crowder had his CEO join his show from her children's playroom inside her home without her consent or knowledge. The transcript says only "his CEO" without naming the person.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the CEO and the show episode in question; obtain the broadcast and any statement from the host's household or Crowder's team on how access was arranged.
claims.transcript_snippet: having the permanent creep Steven Crowder sneak his CEO into my home to join uh Steven's show from my children's playroom without my consent, without my knowledge.

claims.label: Farnsworth Began Removing the Camera Less Than Four Minutes After Charlie Was Hit
claims.claim: The host says Terrell Farnsworth, TPUSA's audio and visual lead who runs Visual Impulse, began taking down the camera behind Charlie Kirk less than four minutes after Charlie was hit.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the timestamp of the first shot with the timestamps of Farnsworth's own recording and of the camera-removal footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: And this turned out was less than four minutes after Charlie was hit. We know he went up uh and he recorded himself.

claims.label: Farnsworth Went Up and Recorded Himself Announcing Charlie Was Dead Before Removing the Camera
claims.claim: The host says Farnsworth went up on stage, recorded himself announcing that Charlie was dead, then went down and began removing the camera behind Charlie in particular.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Farnsworth's self-recorded announcement and its metadata; sequence it against the camera-removal video.
claims.transcript_snippet: We know he went up uh and he recorded himself. He announced that Charlie was dead. He went down and he began removing that camera in particular.

claims.label: Host Says She Has Known Farnsworth for Years and Was Not Initially Suspicious
claims.claim: The host says she had known Farnsworth for years, reached out to him after the event, and at first assumed there was a reasonable explanation for the camera removal.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the host's prior relationship with Farnsworth and the date of first contact after September 10, 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: I knew Terl. You'll recall this, right? I reached out to him. I've known him for years

claims.label: Farnsworth Told the Host He Did Not Want Erika to See Charlie Get Hit in 4K
claims.claim: The host says that on the September 18 call Farnsworth said he did not want to share the back footage because he did not want Erika to see Charlie get hit in 4K, and offered increasingly bizarre reasons for not showing it.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's September 18 call recording or notes, and ask Farnsworth to confirm this stated reason.
claims.transcript_snippet: and he said he didn't want to share it because he didn't want Erika to see Charlie get hit in 4K.

claims.label: Farnsworth First Said He Could Not Send the File, Then Admitted He Could
claims.claim: The host says Farnsworth first said he did not know how to send the file, then admitted he knew how but did not want to for fear that Google might hack him.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the September 18 call recording; compare Farnsworth's two stated reasons for withholding the file.
claims.transcript_snippet: And then he admitted that he did know how to send a file, but he didn't want to do it for fear that Google might hack him.

claims.label: Farnsworth's 1102 Statement Describes a Three-Camera Setup Including a Wider Angle Behind Charlie
claims.claim: The host reads Farnsworth's 1102 statement as saying his camera setup consisted of three angles: one on Charlie, one on the person asking questions, and a wider angle behind Charlie showing the audience and crowd reaction.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the authenticated 1102 statement and TPUSA's camera plot for the UVU event.
claims.transcript_snippet: Our camera setup consisted of three angles. An angle directly on Charlie, an angle on the individual asking questions and a wider angle behind Charlie that showed the audience and the crowd reaction.

claims.label: 1102 Statement Says the Videos Provided to SBI Are a True and Correct Representation of UVU
claims.claim: The host reads Farnsworth's statement as saying the videos as provided to SBI are a true and correct representation of what took place at UVU.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the 1102 and ask SBI which version of each video it received and how authenticity was assessed.
claims.transcript_snippet: These videos as they were provided to SBI are a true and correct representation of what took place at UVU.

claims.label: Host Notes the Statement Cites Three Cameras but Four Videos and Floats a Fourth Moving Camera
claims.claim: The host says Farnsworth's statement describes three cameras but four videos, and suggests a fourth moving camera operated by a person moving side to side, possibly a contractor whose footage Farnsworth obtained. She calls this an assumption.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the source of each of the four videos and the operator of any moving camera at the event.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, let's understand that first portion first. He says that there are four videos that he sent to them. He says that there are three cameras.

claims.label: Robert Golow Operated the Front-Left Camera Facing the Questioner
claims.claim: The host, pointing to a diagram of the three static cameras, says the camera to the front left of Charlie, facing the person asking questions, was operated by Robert Golow (transcribed Golo).
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm camera operator assignments with Visual Impulse crew records or with Golow directly.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, we have one to the front left side of Charlie that is being operated by Robert Golo.

claims.label: Jordan Wilson Operated the Camera the Host Calls Most Critical
claims.claim: The host says the camera circled in blue on her diagram, which she judges would carry the most critical graphic evidence of Charlie being shot, was operated by Jordan Wilson.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Jordan Wilson's role and camera position, and whether that camera's footage was among the four videos sent to SBI.
claims.transcript_snippet: Right? That's the one that was being operated by uh Jordan Wilson. In other words, if I were trying to gather evidence very quickly within minutes of Charlie Kirk being shot, I'd go blue.

claims.label: Host Says the Rear Camera Faced Downward and Traditionally Showed Only the Area Around Charlie's Feet
claims.claim: The host says the third camera was behind Charlie and facing downward, and that traditionally it showed only what was happening below and around Charlie's feet plus some audience.
claims.investigative_direction: Review rear-camera frames from earlier American Comeback Tour stops to establish the usual framing.
claims.transcript_snippet: A, it's facing downward. B, it's behind Charlie. And traditionally, in case you're wondering or need reminding, all it showed was a view of what was happening below and around Charlie's feet

claims.label: Farnsworth Eventually Showed the Host Non-Graphic Back-Camera Footage That Looked Zoomed In
claims.claim: The host says Farnsworth finally showed her non-graphic footage from the camera behind Charlie's head, and that it appeared to YouTuber Nissi to be a zoomed-in shot from that camera.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish when and in what form Farnsworth showed the host the footage; obtain the file shown to her and its metadata.
claims.transcript_snippet: Terl Farnsworth when he finally did show me the completely non-graphic footage from behind Charlie's head presented to me what appeared to her to be a zoomedin shot from that camera

claims.label: Host Infers Farnsworth Copied the SD Card to a Flash Drive and Created Google Links
claims.claim: The host infers from Agent Hull's testimony that Farnsworth inserted the SD card into a computer, copied the footage onto a flash drive, and similarly created Google links, rather than handing over the card on September 10.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the preliminary-hearing transcript and forensic metadata of the flash-drive and Google-link copies to show how they were created.
claims.transcript_snippet: This means that Terl inserted that SD card into a computer and then copied the footage onto a flash drive and similarly created Google links.

claims.label: Host Says the Public Was Told There Was Nothing Unique About the Rear Camera Footage
claims.claim: The host says that when the clip of Farnsworth taking down that camera went viral, people were told there was nothing unique about that camera or its footage, which she calls gaslighting.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect TPUSA statements on the significance of the rear camera and compare them with the 1102 account of the 80704 clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: And then people were gas lit. We were told no, there was nothing unique about that camera. There was nothing unique about that footage in particular.

claims.label: Kolvet Says the SD Cards Are in the Possession of the FBI
claims.claim: In the Tucker Carlson clip, Andrew Kolvet says the SD cards Farnsworth grabbed are in the possession of the FBI and that Farnsworth did not run off with them.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the FBI and SBI whether and when they took custody of any original SD card; compare with Agent Hull's testimony that the 1102 was collected, not the SD card.
claims.transcript_snippet: Well, first of all, they're in the possession of the FBI.

claims.label: Kolvet Says He Personally Asked Farnsworth Why He Took the SD Cards
claims.claim: In the Tucker Carlson clip, Kolvet says he personally asked the staffer why he grabbed the SD cards and that the answer was that he knew people can be evil.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Tucker Carlson segment; ask Kolvet and Farnsworth when and where the exchange took place.
claims.transcript_snippet: I asked him personally. I said, "Why did you do that?" And he looked at me and this was his answer.

claims.label: Host Notes Kolvet Said Cards, Plural, While the Video Shows One Card Taken
claims.claim: The host says Kolvet said Farnsworth took the SD cards, plural, whereas what viewers observed was a single card from that one camera first, which struck her and others as odd.
claims.investigative_direction: Review Sept 10 footage of all camera positions to count how many cards Farnsworth removed and when.
claims.transcript_snippet: But you said cards. And what we noticed was that it was card. It was that one first.

claims.label: 1102 Lists Four Videos of 26, 26, 26 and 23 Minutes
claims.claim: The host reads the lengths of the four videos from Farnsworth's statement as 26, 26, 26 and 23 minutes.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the 1102 and the four source files; compare durations and metadata with the 80704 clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: One is 26 minutes, another one is 26 minutes, another is 26 minutes, and a fourth one is 23 minutes.

claims.label: Host Says It Is Unclear Whether Farnsworth or SBI Made the 80704 Clip, but Farnsworth Touched the Footage First
claims.claim: The host says it is not clear whether Farnsworth or SBI clipped the footage behind Charlie, but that Farnsworth was the first to touch it and the footage ended up clipped.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the metadata and creation log for clip 80704 and the identity of whoever produced it.
claims.transcript_snippet: Like I said, we're not sure if Terl clipped it or if it was SBI that clipped it. We do know that Terrell was the first to touch that footage

claims.label: Host Says Zoomed Footage Was Admitted as a True Representation in the Courtroom Exhibit Dispute
claims.claim: The host says that during the courtroom back-and-forth over exhibits 12.1 and 12.4 the court saw zoomed-in footage and the parties still called it a true representation, which she uses to read the 1102 wording.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the preliminary-hearing transcript for exhibits 12.1 and 12.4 and the objections raised about zoom and cropping.
claims.transcript_snippet: We learned that during the whole back and forth regarding 12.1 and 12.4 before um in the courtroom when they were debating.

claims.label: Host Speculates the 80704 Clip Exists Because the Footage Was Zoomed
claims.claim: The host says it is plausible that the only reason to cut a separate clip from the rear camera is that the footage was zoomed in, since zooming would require creating a new clip. She says she is speculating.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the 80704 clip frame by frame against the full rear-camera file to test for cropping or digital zoom.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's plausible that the only reason they would have to clip that out is because it was zoomed in.

claims.label: Host Says Farnsworth Grabbed Only the One SD Card and Did So Nervously
claims.claim: The host says Farnsworth did not instantly grab all the SD cards but only the one from the camera behind Charlie, and that he did it nervously while looking around to see who was watching.
claims.investigative_direction: Review footage of the other camera positions for any removal of cards from other cameras.
claims.transcript_snippet: because he did not instantly grab all of the SD cards. He grabbed that one and he did it nervously.

claims.label: Footage Shows Farnsworth Taking the Camera Apart and Removing Only the SD Card
claims.claim: The host plays footage in which Farnsworth takes the rear camera apart and removes the SD card rather than taking the whole camera, and argues someone worried about theft would take the whole camera.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original unedited video and the timestamp of the removal.
claims.transcript_snippet: If you're worried about theft, take the whole camera. It's pretty small. It's in your hand. He doesn't do that. He takes it apart and he takes the SD card out.

claims.label: Footage Shows Farnsworth Looking Around After Removing the Card
claims.claim: The host says the footage shows Farnsworth looking around, which she reads as wanting to see who was looking at him, before he looks down at the card and walks around.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the video frame by frame to document where Farnsworth looks and what is in his sight line.
claims.transcript_snippet: And he looks around. He wants to see who's looking at him.

claims.label: Host Says a Network of Government Employees Was Trying to Get the Truth Out
claims.claim: The host says that as she wondered whom she could trust at TPUSA, there was a network of government employees fighting to get the truth out who were wondering whom they could trust as well, and that this is how she has known what Farnsworth did since October.
claims.investigative_direction: The host would need to say how many sources, which agencies and how the exclusive footage reached her; the claim itself is unverifiable without her sources.
claims.transcript_snippet: there was a network of government employees that were fighting to get the truth out and wondering who they could trust as well.

claims.label: Footage Shows Farnsworth Not Going to the Other Cameras Before Texting
claims.claim: The host says that in the newly released footage Farnsworth did not run to the other cameras to grab their SD cards but instead took out his phone and began texting someone.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the complete Sept 10 footage from all angles to confirm no other camera was touched in that period.
claims.transcript_snippet: He doesn't run to the other cameras and try to grab the SD card. Instead, what he does is he whips out his phone and he begins texting with someone.

claims.label: Host Says She Was Told No Police Officer Told Farnsworth to Take the Footage
claims.claim: The host says she is told that no police officer instructed Farnsworth to take that footage in particular. This stands against the Bowyer account that a law enforcement instruction prompted the removal.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask UVU police, SBI and FBI whether any officer instructed Farnsworth to remove a card, and ask Bowyer for the source of his account.
claims.transcript_snippet: Maybe there was some police officer who told him to take that footage in particular. I'm told that didn't happen.

claims.label: Host Says Kathy Nester Asked Whether the Footage Was Edited
claims.claim: The host says defense attorney Kathy Nester (transcribed Netor) asked questions and asserted that the defense does not know whether the footage was edited.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the preliminary-hearing transcript for Nester's questions about editing of the Visual Impulse footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: The questions that Kathy Netor asked thereafter um things that she asserted about they don't know whether or not that footage was edited.

claims.label: Host Says She Is Being Sued by Brian Harpole and Needs the Footage
claims.claim: The host says she is being sued by Brian Harpole, needs the rear-camera footage, and will try to trace its custody and whether it was edited before being given to the FBI by Google link or flash drive.
claims.investigative_direction: Check the docket for the Harpole suit and any discovery requests covering Visual Impulse footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: But I need that footage. I'm being sued by Brian Harpole.

claims.label: Host Says Farnsworth Told Her He Spoke With Erika About That Footage Specifically
claims.claim: The host says Farnsworth told her on the call that he spoke with Erika about that footage specifically, and that she has proof that this is what he told her, though she says he was lying a lot on the call.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the host's call recording; ask Erika Kirk and Farnsworth whether and when they discussed the rear-camera footage.
claims.transcript_snippet: why did Terl tell me that he spoke with Erika about that footage specifically?

claims.label: Host Says the FBI May Assist but Has No Jurisdiction Over a State Crime
claims.claim: The host says the FBI is allowed to assist under the law but does not have jurisdiction over a state crime, and that SBI should have kept the SD card and could have handed the flash drive copy to the FBI.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the written agreement or request under which the FBI assumed evidence custody and the legal basis cited.
claims.transcript_snippet: The FBI under the law is allowed to assist, but they don't have jurisdiction over the crime over the state.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Partners Have Published Details of Her Children's Cars
claims.claim: The host says people partnering with TPUSA have been publishing things about her children's cars and the vehicles they travel in, and asks TPUSA to stop.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the posts publishing the vehicle details and any link between their authors and TPUSA.
claims.transcript_snippet: torment us, publishing things about my children's cars and the vehicles that they travel in.

claims.label: Kirraou Says Patel Described the FBI Role as Offering Expertise to Utah State Police
claims.claim: In the Danny Jones podcast clip, John Kirraou (transcribed Kirao, Kuraku) says Kash Patel was asked early on and said the FBI was just offering its expertise to the Utah State Police.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate Patel's original statement on the FBI's role and compare it with the FBI's actual deployment.
claims.transcript_snippet: So, Kash Patel was asked this early on and he said, "We're just offering the FBI's expertise to the Utah State Police."

claims.label: Kirraou Says the FBI Director Should Not Fly Out With a Planeload of Agents for a State Case
claims.claim: In the clip, Kirraou says offering expertise would mean sending items by FedEx or lending a lab person, and that an FBI director flying out with a planeload of agents is not what you do for a state case that is not federal.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Patel's travel records and the number of FBI personnel deployed to Utah in September 2025.
claims.transcript_snippet: You don't have the FBI director fly out there with a with a plane load of FBI agents. It's not a federal case.

claims.label: Host Says Kash Patel Apparently Shut Down Joe Kent's Inquiry Into Foreign Ties
claims.claim: The host says it is very strange that Kash Patel apparently shut down Joe Kent, who wanted to investigate whether there were foreign ties.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek Joe Kent's on-record account and documents on the halted NCTC inquiry.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's very strange that Kash Patel apparently shut down um Joe Kent who wanted to investigate whether or not there are foreign ties.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Is Upset With Joe Kent but Not With Kash Patel
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA is upset with the person who wanted to investigate foreign ties but not with Kash Patel, and that TPUSA attends events with Patel.
claims.investigative_direction: Compile TPUSA public statements about Kent and Patel and a list of joint appearances.
claims.transcript_snippet: And then we had Turning Point USA who's upset with the person who wanted to investigate those ties but not upset with Kash Patel going to events with Kash Patel.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Intentionally Tried to Trip Her Into a Lawsuit
claims.claim: The host says that, as she said before, they were intentionally trying to trip her into a lawsuit, and that people on the other side are eager for her to be sued.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the debate agreement, the questions put to her and any legal communications around the debate for evidence of an intent to provoke a suit.
claims.transcript_snippet: Uh but as I said as um they were intentionally trying to trip me into a lawsuit. You can see they're all salivating for me to be sued.

claims.label: Host Says the Case Has Been Discussed on Shawn Ryan and Joe Rogan
claims.claim: The host says the case has gone mainstream and been discussed on Shawn Ryan and more recently on Joe Rogan, where guests Mark Normand, Shane Gillis and Ari Schaefer discussed the Tyler Robinson case and the PR campaign around Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the Rogan episode number and date and verify its guest list.
claims.transcript_snippet: whether that's Shawn Ryan or more recently Joe Rogan who had a laugh alongside his guests Mark Normand, Shane Gillis and Ari Schaefer

claims.label: A Rogan Panelist Says He Is Leaning More Toward Candace Owens as Time Goes On
claims.claim: In the Rogan clip a speaker, not identified in the transcript, says the more time goes on, the more he is leaning towards Candace Owens.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the speaker from the Rogan episode audio.
claims.transcript_snippet: The more the more time goes on, the more I'm leaning towards Candace Owens.

claims.label: Rogan Panel Remarks on Erika Kirk Coming Out With Sparklers Behind Her
claims.claim: In the Rogan clip a panelist asks whether it is weird that a woman comes out with sparklers behind her, in a discussion the host introduced as being about the PR campaign around Erika Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Match the remark to a specific Erika Kirk appearance with pyrotechnics and its date.
claims.transcript_snippet: You don't think it's weird the lady comes out to sparkers behind her?

claims.label: Host Says She Began Commenting in December After Erika Denied Charlie Sent Fear Messages the Night Before
claims.claim: The host says she only weighed in beginning in December, when Erika Kirk went on a press tour and explicitly shared something untrue: that the night before, Charlie was not sending messages saying he feared for his life.
claims.investigative_direction: Find Erika Kirk's December 2025 press-tour statements on the night before and compare them with the text messages TPUSA later confirmed.
claims.transcript_snippet: I only weighed in beginning in December when she went on to a press tour and explicitly shared something that was untrue that the night before Charlie was not sending messages saying that he feared for his life.

claims.label: Host Says Erika Kirk Described Charlie as So Excited About UVU That He Could Not Sleep
claims.claim: The host says Erika Kirk described Charlie as so excited to do what he always does, so excited to go to UVU, that he couldn't sleep.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Erika Kirk interview in which she says this and its date.
claims.transcript_snippet: When she says he was just so excited to do what he's always done, so excited to go to UVU, he couldn't sleep.

claims.label: Host Disputes That Charlie Lost Sleep From Excitement About an Already-Visited Stop
claims.claim: The host says she has never known Charlie not to sleep over a tour stop at a place he had already been, and says it makes more sense that he could not sleep because he thought he would be killed.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect accounts from people who traveled with Charlie about his sleep habits before tour stops.
claims.transcript_snippet: Never known Charlie to to not sleep over a tour stop of a place that he's already been.

claims.label: Host Says the Independent Investigators May Have Made Errors but Not Knowingly
claims.claim: The host says that when she says we she means independent investigators including Nissi, Baron Coleman, Ian Carroll and Coach Colin, and that they have likely made some errors but not knowingly, and wish to correct them.
claims.investigative_direction: Track the specific corrections the group has issued and which claims remain disputed.
claims.transcript_snippet: Sure, I'm sure we have made some errors, but we did not make them knowingly.

claims.label: Host Says Wilson Came to Believe She Received Texts on Her Phone During the Debate
claims.claim: The host says that by the end of the debate Andrew Wilson had become a conspiracy theorist who thought she was receiving text messages on her phone to remind her of the charges, and then thought she was receiving them through Signal or Telegram.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the debate recording for Wilson's remarks about texts, Signal or Telegram.
claims.transcript_snippet: Andrew Wilson by the end of it into a conspiracy theorist who thought that I was receiving text messages on my phone uh to remind me of what the charges were

claims.label: Host Says She Offered to Hand Over Her Phone During the Debate
claims.claim: The host says that in response to Wilson's suspicion she offered her phone to show there was no hidden messaging, as a demonstration that transparency debunks conspiracy.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm from the debate recording the exchange about the phone.
claims.transcript_snippet: What did I do? At first, I said I said, "Here's my phone.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Gave Wilson a Never-Before-Seen Text Message
claims.claim: The host says that when TPUSA finally shared some daylight, it chose Andrew Wilson and gave him a text message that has not been seen before.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Wilson and TPUSA to release the text message and state its source and date.
claims.transcript_snippet: you pick Andrew Wilson and you give him a text message. Never before seen, by the way.

claims.label: Host Says the Wilson Text Message Is Still Unseen and Only Teased
claims.claim: The host says the message is still never before seen because it has not been released, that Wilson is teasing it, and that knowing it exists and was in his hand is already helpful to her.
claims.investigative_direction: Watch for release of the message and compare it with the night-before messages TPUSA has acknowledged.
claims.transcript_snippet: It's still never before seen because we haven't seen it. He's teasing it.

claims.label: Host Says Her Husband Already Had the House Swept for Bugs
claims.claim: The host says her husband George already had the house swept for bugs, as the first thing he did after they learned the Crowder crew had been in the house.
claims.investigative_direction: Not independently checkable without a sweep report; the claim is the host's own statement.
claims.transcript_snippet: of course, George has already had the house swept for bugs. That was like the first thing he did

claims.label: Crucible Account Corrected by a Community Note on a Probable Cause Warrant Quote
claims.claim: The host says the Crucible account posted that the warrant said officers spoke to the mom, and that a community note on X explained this is not a direct quotation from the mother but an officer's statement in a probable cause warrant.
claims.investigative_direction: Find the Crucible post and the attached community note and compare against the probable cause affidavit text.
claims.transcript_snippet: Twitter just had to come in and explain to him, no, this this is not a direct quotation from the mom.

claims.label: Host Says Wilson Was Turning Point's Horse Despite TPUSA Saying It Had Nothing to Do With Him
claims.claim: The host says she knew Wilson was Turning Point's horse, citing TPUSA's statement that it had nothing to do with him and then his opening statement. She says no brain cell was split between Erika, Kolvet and Neff.
claims.investigative_direction: Collect TPUSA statements disclaiming Wilson and any communications or payments between TPUSA and Wilson or Crucible.
claims.transcript_snippet: I knew that it was Turning Point's horse. Even just them saying we we have nothing to do with him and then his opening statement, it just is incredible.

claims.label: Host Says Wilson's Opening Statement Turned to Israel
claims.claim: The host says Andrew Wilson's debate opening statement started talking about Israel, which she finds strange.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the debate transcript for the length and content of the Israel passage in Wilson's opening.
claims.transcript_snippet: His opening statement, he starts talking about Israel. Why?

claims.label: Host Says Wilson Wanted to Absolve Israel Without Proving His Debate Claim
claims.claim: The host says that if Wilson had proven his claim of overwhelming evidence that Tyler Robinson did it, that would naturally absolve Israel, but he instead wanted to absolve Israel without proving the claim.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the debate resolution as agreed with Wilson's actual arguments.
claims.transcript_snippet: He wanted to absolve Israel from any guilt without having to prove his statement. Weird focus.

claims.label: Host Says the Night-Before Text Would Have Been the First Message Handed Over to Joe Kent
claims.claim: Responding to a viewer comment, the host says that if the messages being handed over were of people Charlie felt threatened by or anything significant, the text that he feared the left would kill him would have been the first one handed over.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Joe Kent and Kolvet exactly which messages were provided to Kent and when.
claims.transcript_snippet: Of course, if he was handing messages that hand messages over as he was uh of people that Charlie felt threatened by or anything that could be significant, that would have been the first message that was handed over.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Denied the Messages for Four Months Then Had Erika Deny It on Glenn Beck
claims.claim: The host says TPUSA denied or stayed silent for four months and then had Erika deny the night-before messages on the Glenn Beck show.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Glenn Beck interview segment and any earlier TPUSA statements on the messages.
claims.transcript_snippet: Instead, they denied it for four months and then had Erika deny it on Glenn Beck or rather stayed mum on it for four months

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Later Admitted Messages Exist but Said They Mention the Left
claims.claim: The host says that when the denial backfired, TPUSA said there were messages but that they say the left, and she calls the timeline suspicious in her opinion.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full text of the night-before messages and the dates TPUSA first acknowledged them.
claims.transcript_snippet: And then when it backfired, they were like, "Oh, no, there's messages, but like it says the left."
